title: Coverage ledger
description: model/coverage/<batch>.json: the files one extraction pass reviewed at one commit. tools/coverage.mjs checks that the ledgers for the modelled commit account for every required file.

commit.description: Full commit the files were read at; must equal meta.source.commit.

summary.description: What this batch covered, e.g. `crates/axo-pty and crates/axo-ipc`.

path.description: A file, or a directory ending in `/` for development, vendored, and generated trees.

outcome.description: read: read in full in the extraction session (recorded automatically). development: about how the system is developed, tested, built, or published rather than how it behaves; not read in full, with a note saying why. vendored or generated: not read, with a note naming the origin. modelled and no-behaviour: recorded by earlier versions.

note.description: Required in spirit for vendored and generated: where it comes from.
